analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($357.52) vs SMA5/20/50 ($361.93/$349.01/$355.83) — below short-term, above mid-term, indicating mid-term bullish position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($350.87/$329.37) — maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (75.9%) + current price level approximately 12.5% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (61.1 → 52.2) + neutral assessment + continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.8129 → 2.5792) + holding steady assessment + no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $349.01) + band width at 18.96%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($351.08) + confirmed support based on pivot.
· Swing resistance ($373.16) + potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation) + maintaining uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.57x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase assessment (uptrend) + entry conditions met, wait-and-see if RSI drops below 45 or MACD forms a death cross.
